payload_json.thesis_statement: VST can compound earnings above consensus as AI infrastructure demand pulls forward power and grid investment.

business_quality.summary: Vistra has meaningful exposure to infrastructure spending and enough business quality to warrant a structured review.
business_quality.moat_assessment: Scale, installed base, and channel depth support pricing power.

estimates_and_expectations.consensus_summary: Consensus expects steady growth but remains cautious on macro-sensitive industrial demand.

positioning.institutional_positioning: High-quality buyers are present, but generalists still debate whether the AI grid demand is durable.

payload_json.steelman_bear_case: The bear case is that AI data-center demand is pulled forward, industrial demand rolls over as rates stay high, and backlog normalizes before estimates can move materially higher.

bear_case_evidence.claim: VST is exposed to cyclical industrial demand.
bear_case_evidence.title: VST macro sensitivity remains a risk

payload_json.what_bear_case_misses: The bear case underweights the duration of utility and data-center capex plans, which are tied to multi-year power constraints rather than one quarter of industrial activity.

conviction.justification: VST has enough evidence for a moderate stub rating, with explicit variant evidence and a named uncertainty.
conviction.primary_uncertainty: Macro conditions or earnings revisions could move against the theme before the market reprices the opportunity.
